name: Ghislain
source:
A knight from Chrysantheme. In his motherland he holds the nickname of "The Feared Blade of Chrysantheme" amongst the soldiers for all of his numerous military deeds. He has a fastidious and strict nature to himself and others, but he will definitely devote his loyalty to a liege that he has recognized.

His mansion can be reached by going up a long set of captivating stairs. The living room has a solemn atmosphere and the walls are adorned with weapons. The interior is suited for a soldier like him.

[from [url=http://otome-jikan.net/2014/04/03/reines-des-fleurs-introduction/]otome-jikan[/url]]
